chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 532: The Dragon Vein Breaks – Zhuge Yuan's Desperate Ritual
chapter_meta_description: Zhuge Yuan reveals the terrifying truth of the human-faced ox: it is a Yu, a prophecy creature whose song means the Great Qi dragon vein is about to break. History itself is at stake.
og_title: The Dragon Vein of Great Qi Is About to Snap
og_description: A single prophetic song threatens to erase an entire dynasty. Li Huowang must pay a terrible price to give Zhuge Yuan the power to act.
twitter_title: The "Yu" Has Spoken – Great Qi's End Is Nigh
twitter_description: A creature born only in chaos sings its omen and dies. The fate of an empire now rests on a ritual that costs Li Huowang his own flesh.

lore_anchors.definition: A prophetic creature born only during times of great chaos; it speaks one inauspicious sentence as an omen and dies immediately. Its words are always about to come true.
A metaphysical energy line in Chinese feng shui and imperial mysticism that sustains a dynasty's prosperity and legitimacy. In this novel, it also anchors the historical timeline itself.
Li Huowang's unique Heart-Element ability to give physical, tangible form to hallucinations and intangible concepts. The cost scales with the importance of the entity being materialized.
A sword made from Li Huowang's own spine; it contains the spirit of another Zhuge Yuan and can be used as a vessel for ritual inscription and prophecy.
A mysterious, high-level divine entity invoked by Zhuge Yuan in his final prayer to protect the Great Qi dragon vein.
A desolate, abandoned palace complex within the imperial city, used to sequester disgraced consorts. In this chapter, it is the site of the Yu's birth and death.

cultural_notes_faq.a: A prophecy creature born spontaneously during times of great chaos. It speaks one inauspicious sentence and dies immediately. Its words are always about something that is about to happen.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the dragon vein breaking such a big deal?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In this novel, a dragon vein anchors an entire historical timeline. If it breaks, the dynasty it sustains may cease to exist, as happened a thousand years ago when Great Liang emerged from the broken Great Qi.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did giving Zhuge Yuan a physical body hurt Li Huowang so much?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The cost of "Cultivating the False into Reality" scales with the importance of the entity being materialized. Zhuge Yuan is tied to the fate of the dragon vein, making him far more "real" and costly to manifest than the monk or Peng Longteng.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What did Zhuge Yuan write with the Spine Sword?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He performed a ritual seal or celestial memorial, writing a binding message to the earth's spiritual infrastructure. The blood sank into the ground, and the paper spontaneously combusted, indicating the message had been delivered to the appropriate cosmic authority.
